## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
library(bigrquery)
library(httr)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
```

```{r}

# ---- credentials and constants --------------------------------------------
apikey   <- "95A548D2-108A-39D9-AAFA-ABC87DFAE9FD"
states   <- state.abb           # "AL", "AK", …, "WY"
years    <- 2000:2020
base_get <- "https://quickstats.nass.usda.gov/api/get_counts/" # row-count endpoint
base_csv <- "https://quickstats.nass.usda.gov/api/api_GET/"    # CSV endpoint

```


```{r}

# ── polite wrappers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
rate  <- rate_delay(pause = 0.6)         # ≤ ~2 req s⁻¹
slow  <- slowly(GET, rate = rate)        # honour the delay
retry <- purrr::possibly(function(...) { # retry on 403/500
           RETRY("GET", ..., times = 5, pause_min = 2, pause_cap = 30)
         }, otherwise = NULL, quiet = TRUE)

# ── one pull; returns data.frame or NULL ─────────────────────────────────
pull_corn_area <- function(st, yr) {

  qry <- list(
    key               = apikey,
    commodity_desc    = "CORN",
    statisticcat_desc = "AREA HARVESTED",
    unit_desc         = "ACRES",
    agg_level_desc    = "COUNTY",
    freq_desc         = "ANNUAL",
    state_alpha       = st,
    year              = yr,
    format            = "CSV"
  )

  # 1. how many rows?
  cnt_resp <- retry(slow(base_get, query = qry))
  if (is.null(cnt_resp)) return(NULL)                  # network failure
  cnt <- content(cnt_resp, "parsed", simplifyVector = TRUE)$count
  if (cnt == 0) {
    message("  • ", st, " ", yr, " = 0 rows (skipped)")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # 2. fetch the CSV
  csv_resp <- retry(slow(base_csv, query = qry))
  if (is.null(csv_resp)) return(NULL)
  read_csv(content(csv_resp, "raw"), show_col_types = FALSE)
}

```
